instruction: Candid intimate photograph, vertical medium shot. In a minimalist indoor space with a marble wall, a shirtless tattooed man (R1) sits behind a woman in a black dress (R2). The man (R1) looks down lovingly at the woman, while the woman (R2) leans back against him with a gentle smile and closed eyes. He wraps his heavily tattooed arms around her, holding her hands. Soft, warm lighting enhances the peaceful, affectionate atmosphere.
